chapters.chapter_name: Design of machine elements subjected to direct stresses
content: Illustration of machine components subjected to direct stresses with
numerical examples, design procedure for cotter joint, knuckle joint,
welded joint (fillet and lap joint), riveted joint, threaded joint

chapters.chapter_name: Design of machine elements subjected to bending stresses
content: Fundamental principal of bending and its equation, modulus of
elasticity for various sections of elements subjected to pure bending
like lever, beam, axels etc., Types of lever and its design procedure,
design of leaf spring
General design process and factors to be considered, material
selection for design, stress concentration, factor of safety, Bearing
classification and designation, standardization and preferred
numbers.

chapters.chapter_name: Design of machine elements subjected to direct and twisting

procedure, types of coupling, design of muff and flange coupling,
